力。任何现实，只要无法不断恢复自身，就无法真正持续；任何结
构，只要无法面对扰动，就终将瓦解。稳定并不是变化的对立面，而
是变化之中的持续组织能力。现实之所以能够跨越时间，并不是因为
时间停止流动，而是因为系统能够不断回应时间所带来的改变。这意
味着，现实开始出现另一种更深层的特性。系统不再只是形成结构，
也不再只是形成连接与组织，而开始形成维持自身的能力。当部分结
构发生改变，其余结构能够重新调整；当某些路径失去作用，新的路
径能够逐渐建立；当环境不断变化，组织方式能够不断适应。现实开

claims.text: An organization can endure despite replacement of its constituent elements when it continually reorganizes those elements and maintains its mode of operation, rather than depending on every individual element remaining unchanged.

This endurance is presented as a dynamic capacity: when parts change, remaining structures can readjust; when prior pathways cease to work, new pathways can gradually be established; and organizational arrangements can adapt to environmental change.

The fragment illustrates this with a city: buildings, roads, facilities, population, and industries may change, while the city continues through its ability to restore overall functions such as transport, resources, production, exchange, and order.

answer.boundary: The supplied fragment supports a general account of continuity through ongoing reorganization and adaptation, illustrated by a city. It does not specify necessary institutional mechanisms, thresholds of replacement, or criteria for determining when an organization has ceased to be the same organization.
